title: Speed up login-history lookups
description:
The new login-history screen is slow. Add a composite index on users(last_login_at) to support the 'recent logins per user' query pattern.

Scope:
- Add one index to the users table
- Purely additive; no data changes

Migration file: migrations/006_add_login_audit_index.sql. Routine additive migration — follow the standard migration flow.
scope: Additive index on users(last_login_at) in user-service. No data changes.
